contracts.name: Agent Skills specification
assumptions: A skill is a directory containing SKILL.md.
The portable frontmatter contract includes name and description.

contracts.name: Codex skill discovery
assumptions: Codex supports repository and user skill discovery.
Portable skills do not require model-provider API calls.

contracts.name: Omarchy Quattro shell contract
assumptions: Quattro plugins use a root manifest.json and hosted QML entry points.
Third-party plugin code executes inside the long-running shell process.

contracts.name: Omarchy Plugin Workbench project definition
assumptions: Generated root plugins declare pluginPath as '.'.
Project commands are exact argument vectors and remain untrusted until the owner approves them.
Workflow capabilities require separate local approval and do not name an agent host.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace submission form
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-09-12: Kids is an accepted category.
Tags use form display labels; preserve exact headings and five acknowledgments.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace security review semantics
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-09-13: the root README is scanned; privilege negation recognizes specific forms, not arbitrary prose.
Compatibility success is separate from exact-commit security disposition, maintainer approval and publication.
The portable privilege advisory intentionally reports all tool references, including negated prose; it does not reproduce the authoritative baseline.

contracts.name: Omarchy Quattro multiselect settings example
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-09-22: Quattro uses multiselect in barWidget.schema.
Multiselect options may be objects with value, label and description; an options array is required by this portable checker.
